choices.text: Can I have a new name?

ask.speaker: fern
ask.text: Can I have a new name?

think.speaker: sorrel
think.text: A new name? Hm. Tell me what you would be called, and I will think on it.

named.speaker: sorrel
named.text: Then from now on, the Clan will know you as {player_name}.

kept.speaker: sorrel
kept.text: No? Then you stay {player_name} a while longer.
